scope: spline pion_sector/pipS6o on variation shard 1. 3D Bayesian phi_h, 423 fitted cells, Q2-y 1-17. RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication. 29 empty histograms are N/A, including (12,8), (3,4), (3,5), (3,25).
start_mode: manual. Spline B windows are tight (median width 0.020, 945 of 1390 narrower than 0.05), so --use_spline_init was not used. Changed bins are in refine_init.py, a copy of nominal_init.py.
changed: Initial run_shard was not treated as finished. 14 bins were trapped by a small first-pass moment start: the second pass only moves a parameter halfway, so A(1+B cos phi+C cos 2phi) was too flat. Starts were moved to the histogram cosine and limits that excluded it were widened in refine_init.py. Remade Q2-y 1 2 3 6 9 10 11 13 16 with --unfolding_3D --fit_corrections Bayesian --fit_error_source histogram --fit_init_file, no pass cap and no chi-squared stop. All 14 improved. Worst (1,19) 14.81 to 1.88. Other cells in those Q2-y bins did not move, and unselected Q2-y bins are unchanged. JSON still has 423 cells. The shared manual initializer and the universal spline file were not edited.
left_bins: No 5D family, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Histogram shapes that disagree with a neighbor were kept, including (2,14) B 0.183 beside neighbor -0.099; (13,10) B -0.243 beside neighbor -0.036; (9,19) B -0.238 beside neighbor -0.411.
unresolved: The best three-parameter curve still misses the histogram in (11,24) 5.15, (12,14) free_large, (12,24) free_diverged, (3,29) free_diverged, (4,25) free_diverged, (7,35) free_diverged, (8,24) free_large.
